Extract activity patterns of humans or mosquitoes

Source: R/database.R
list_activity.Rd

Returns activity patterns from the package database matching the provided criteria.

Usage

list_activity(
  species = "Anopheles gambiae",
  sampling = "HBI",
  country = NULL,
  site = NULL
)

Arguments

species

Name of the species. Use "Homo sapiens" for human patterns. Default is "Anopheles gambiae".

sampling

Sampling type: "IND", "BED", "HBI", "HBO", "ABO", or "HB". Default is "HBI".

country

Country name. Default NULL returns all countries.

site

Site name. Default NULL returns all sites.

Value

Data frame with columns: id, species, sampling, country, site, variable (time point), value.

Author

Monica Golumbeanu, monica.golumbeanu@swisstph.ch

Examples

humans_indoors = list_activity(species = "Homo sapiens", sampling = "IND",
site = "Rachuonyo")
print(humans_indoors)
